item.description:
Beta 50
Improvements · English interface: the 26 built-in wallpapers now have English names; counts use proper singular and plural (no more “Every 1 minutes” or “1 items”); spelling is consistently American and capitalization follows macOS conventions; the “Automation” sidebar item is now “Auto Switch”. · The status on the Displays page reflects what the display is actually showing: “No wallpaper” when nothing is set, and videos and images no longer show a frame-rate cap that only applies to web wallpapers. · When fewer than two wallpapers are in a timed rotation, the countdown is replaced by a short explanation instead of counting down to nothing. · The empty-library hint and the Add Wallpaper panel now mention Wallpaper Engine wallpaper folders.
Fixes · The Order picker in the English Auto Switch page read “In order: In order”. · The “Turn On Audio Reactive” button in the English inspector was cut off. · The pet’s “Listening to…” line said the wrong number of apps in English and used a Chinese comma. · A broken scene package was reported as an unreadable project.json.

Beta 50
改进 · 英文界面：内置的 26 张壁纸显示英文名；数量分单复数（不再有「Every 1 minutes」「1 items」）；统一成美式拼写和 macOS 的大小写习惯；侧栏「自动切换」改叫 Auto Switch。 · 显示器页的「状态」按这块屏上实际放的东西显示：没设壁纸写「没有壁纸」，视频和图片不再显示只对网页壁纸有用的帧率上限。 · 定时轮播里参与的壁纸不到两张时，不再空倒计时，改成一句说明。 · 壁纸库空着时的提示、「添加壁纸…」面板的说明写上了 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸文件夹。
修复 · 英文界面「自动切换」页的选择框显示成「In order: In order」。 · 英文界面检查器里「打开音频响应」按钮的文字被截断。 · 桌宠「正在听」那句英文意思说反了，还夹着中文顿号。 · 场景（Scene）壁纸的场景包坏了时，报错说成「读不懂 project.json」。
